verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is now part of LegalZoom, and its Virtual Mail is documented as working with LegalZoom business formation services, including complimentary Secretary of State status reports. That covers the LLC-formation pairing from the same provider, and the address can also be listed on public records for privacy. Nothing in the evidence shows lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification or residency-grade addresses. Missing for 10: lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, residency-grade addresses, detail on how formation and address bundling works, independent corroboration.
